event.name: HYROX Budapest
event.scheduleNote: Provisional, from hyrox.com. Individual start times are published ~3 days before. Start-time changes are not allowed.
event.checkIn: Opens 90 minutes before your division's first wave. Bring photo ID; check in only on your race day and only for yourself.

frame.units: organizer-map px (page rendered 1198 px wide, y down)
frame.calibration: No scale bar on the map. Chosen so a run (2 full laps + OUT→IN, per the 'enter on 3rd IN sighting' rule) measures ~1000 m. Cross-check: hall depth becomes 109 m vs 107 m N-S for Hall A in OSM.

anchor.what: SE corner of Hall A (OSM way 192361425)

geo.note: Map top is north: Hall A's long axis runs E-W in OSM and Gate 3 lies south of the hall.

runCourse.note: Counter-clockwise on the map: west along the north side, south, east along the south side, north up the east side.

roxzone.note: The Roxzone corridor runs along the north side between the course and the stations. Every station has a one-way ↓ entry and ↑ exit.

start.note: Line up in the warm-up area, go through the Red Bull Start Tunnel and join the course at the north-east corner, running west.

stations.note: Lanes run across the station. When done, walk back up the narrow return strip on the west side (↑ arrow).
Shares the return strip with Sled Push: exit up the ↑ strip between the two stations.
Down the west half of the lane, back up the east half.
2 laps of the lane: down, round the turn marker (↻) and back up — twice.
Lunge down the lane, turn, lunge back up.
No Roxzone exit after Wall Balls: leave through the south end straight into the Finish Zone.

finish.note: Out of the south end of Wall Balls and across the yellow finish line. Medics are in the Finish Zone.

arrival.name: Main entrance – Gate 3
arrival.note: Albertirsai út side. In reality Gate 3 is ~160 m south of Hall A; the organizer map draws it closer.

arrival.name: Athlete registration
arrival.note: Inside the Gate 3 building. Photo ID.

photoSpotsNote: Suggested by the planner, not designated by the organizer. All spots are inside the spectator zone (black on the organizer map) or on a grandstand. Never stand in a hatched crossing point.

photoSpots.name: Finish line, side-on
photoSpots.tip: Spectator corner right beside the yellow finish line; athletes cross it a few metres in front of you. The busiest spot in the hall, so arrive before your athlete's last run.

photoSpots.name: West grandstand – Wall Balls
photoSpots.tip: Seated and slightly raised, looking across the whole Wall Balls station. Good for the final 100 reps; take a top row for a clear line over heads.

photoSpots.name: East grandstand – Wall Balls & finish approach
photoSpots.tip: Southern end of the east grandstand, looking down the station towards its exit into the Finish Zone. Lets you shoot the last reps and then turn for the finish.

photoSpots.name: Sled Push, head-on
photoSpots.tip: Narrow spectator strip between Sled Push and the SkiErg. Lanes run across the station, so every second length comes straight at you – strained faces guaranteed.

photoSpots.name: Sled Pull, side view
photoSpots.tip: Strip between the Finish Zone and Sled Pull, low and close to the lanes: hand-over-hand rope pulls and the walks back.

photoSpots.name: Farmers Carry turnaround
photoSpots.tip: Below the end of the Farmers Carry and Sandbag Lunges lanes. Athletes come straight towards you and turn at the ↻ marker.

photoSpots.name: Run course – east straight
photoSpots.tip: Open spectator area beside the course, heading north. Every athlete passes here twice per run (16 times per race). The easiest place to wait for one person; food and drinks behind you.

photoSpots.name: Run course – south straight
photoSpots.tip: The longest straight. Athletes run left to right (east) past you – good for panning shots, with the ceremony stage at the west end.

places.name: Bus stop “III. kapu”
places.note: Right at Gate 3. Lines not verified.

places.name: Kőbánya felső vasútállomás (tram 37, rail)
places.note: Tram 37 from Blaha Lujza tér (per Hungexpo). ~450 m to Gate 3.

places.name: P4 visitor car park (P4 látogatói parkoló)
places.note: OSM way 207508333. ~230 m from Gate 3 as the crow flies. Not confirmed as HYROX parking.

transport: Metro M2 to Örs vezér tere, then bus 10 (route given by Hungexpo).
Tram 37 from Blaha Lujza tér to Kőbánya felső vasútállomás, then walk ~450 m west to Gate 3.
parking: P4 visitor car park, east of Hall A off Albertirsai út (marked P on the map) – free for visitors at Hungexpo's own exhibitions; NOT confirmed for HYROX.
Street parking on Albertirsai út is paid (run by Kőbányai Vagyonkezelő).
city.unknowns: No HYROX athlete guide for Budapest was published at the time of building; parking for this event is unconfirmed.
